column1: FFP once reserved cannot be cancelled and should be transfused within 24 hours.
Please double-check patient identification before transfusion.
Report any transfusion reactions immediately to the blood bank.
Store blood components at the correct temperature at all times.
Leukoreduced components are recommended for transplant patients.
CMV-negative blood is required for infants and immunocompromised patients.
Irradiated blood products should be used for patients at risk for GvHD.
A new sample is required for cross-matching every 3 days.
Return unused blood components to the blood bank within 30 minutes.
Do not add any medications to the blood bag or tubing.
Ensure the blood filter is used for all red cell and platelet transfusions.
